\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{shapes.geometric}
\typeout{STZ PGF VERSION \pgfversion}
\pagestyle{empty}
\makeatletter
\newwrite\fixtureout
\immediate\openout\fixtureout=geometry.txt
\newcommand\fixedshape[8]{%
\begin{pgfpicture}\begingroup\normalfont
\pgfkeys{#7}%
\setbox\pgfnodeparttextbox=\hbox{}%
\wd\pgfnodeparttextbox=#3pt\ht\pgfnodeparttextbox=#4pt\dp\pgfnodeparttextbox=#5pt%
\pgfsetlinewidth{#6pt}%
\immediate\write\fixtureout{CASE #1}%
\pgfmathsetlength\pgf@x{1em}\pgfmathsetlength\pgf@y{1ex}%
\immediate\write\fixtureout{FONT \the\pgf@x,\the\pgf@y}%
\let\originalusepath\pgfusepath
\def\pgfusepath##1{\pgfgetpath\fixturepath\immediate\write\fixtureout{PAINT ##1; PATH \meaning\fixturepath}\originalusepath{##1}}%
\pgfmultipartnode{#2}{center}{fixture}{\pgfusepath{stroke}}%
\foreach\anchorname in {#8}{\pgfpointanchor{fixture}{\anchorname}\immediate\write\fixtureout{ANCHOR \anchorname; \the\pgf@x,\the\pgf@y}}%
\endgroup\end{pgfpicture}\par}
\newif\ifstzdartfitting
\let\stzoriginalreciprocal\pgfmathreciprocal@
\def\pgfmathreciprocal@#1{\edef\stzreciprocalinput{#1}\stzoriginalreciprocal{#1}\ifstzdartfitting\immediate\write\fixtureout{DARTRECIP \stzreciprocalinput; \pgfmathresult}\fi}
\let\stzoriginalresavedmacro\pgf@sh@resavedmacro
\def\pgf@sh@resavedmacro#1#2{\stzoriginalresavedmacro{#1}{%
\edef\stzmacroname{\string#1}\edef\stzdartname{\string\installdartparameters}%
\ifx\stzmacroname\stzdartname\stzdartfittingtrue\fi%
#2%
\ifstzdartfitting\immediate\write\fixtureout{DARTFITTING \dartlength,\taillength,\halftailseparation,\deltax}\stzdartfittingfalse\fi}}
\makeatother
\begin{document}
\fixedshape{star-zero-outer-negative-inner}{star}{0}{0}{0}{0.4}{/pgf/inner xsep=-1pt,/pgf/inner ysep=-1pt,/pgf/outer xsep=3pt,/pgf/outer ysep=3pt,/pgf/minimum width=0pt,/pgf/minimum height=0pt,/pgf/star point height=1pt}{center,text,base,mid,east,west,north,south,north east,north west,south east,south west,0,13,45,90,181,270,315,-30,outer point 1,inner point 1,outer point 2,inner point 2,outer point 3,inner point 3,outer point 4,inner point 4,outer point 5,inner point 5}
